title: Gemini’s new version '3.8 Live' launches in India: Google Gemini will now respond in local dialects and off...
key_facts: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking.
The model is aimed at completing tasks during voice conversations, using tools in the background.
In Google Docs it can draft a structure for a client proposal by voice; in Gmail it can pull requirements from long threads and draft replies.
It supports around 97 languages with switching mid-conversation.
Latency is down 20% and context retention has doubled compared with older models, per the article.
Custom voice profiles were added; it handles local dialects and accents better.
Search Live will get it; some features are Pro-only.
quote_evidence: Gemini can now recognise around 97 languages.

Compared with older models, latency has been reduced by 20% (making conversations feel more natural, like human speech), and context retention has doubled, helping Gemini remember previous points during longer conversations.
why_it_matters_hint: Voice assistants are moving from answering questions to carrying out tasks while you talk.
notes: Single regional outlet; performance figures are not independently tested. Headline says India launch, body text does not detail India availability.
